# bloxone_cdc_destination_splunk (Resource)

Manages a Splunk Destination.

The Splunk Destination object sends Cloud Data Connector (CDC) flow data to a Splunk indexer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bloxone_cdc_destination_splunk" "example" {
  name         = "example_cdc_destination_splunk"
  address      = "splunk.example.com:9997"
  indexer_name = "main"
}

resource "bloxone_cdc_destination_splunk" "example_with_optional" {
  name               = "example_cdc_destination_splunk_optional"
  address            = "10.10.10.1:9997,10.10.10.2:9997"
  indexer_name       = "main"
  output_data_format = "CIM"
  description        = "Example CDC Splunk destination"
  enabled            = true

  tags = {
    site = "Site A"
  }
}

# Splunk with a forwarder certificate, verifying the indexer certificate against a CA certificate
resource "bloxone_cdc_destination_splunk" "example_with_certificates" {
  name                       = "example_cdc_destination_splunk_certificates"
  address                    = "splunk2.example.com:9997"
  indexer_name               = "main"
  insecure_mode              = false
  ca_certificate             = file("${path.module}/ca_cert.pem")
  certificate                = file("${path.module}/forwarder_cert.pem")
  certificate_key_passphrase = "example_passphrase"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) The FQDN or IP address and port of the Splunk indexer, e.g. `splunk.example.com:9997`. Multiple indexers are separated by commas, e.g. `10.10.10.1:9997,10.10.10.2:9997`.
- `indexer_name` (String) The name of the Splunk index the data is sent to.
- `name` (String) The name of the Splunk destination.

### Optional

- `ca_certificate` (String, Sensitive) The CA certificate used to verify the Splunk indexer certificate, in PEM format.
- `certificate` (String, Sensitive) The Splunk forwarder certificate, in PEM format.
- `certificate_key_passphrase` (String, Sensitive) The passphrase of the Splunk forwarder certificate key.
- `description` (String) The description of the Splunk destination. May contain 0 to 256 characters.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the Splunk destination is enabled. Defaults to _true_.
- `insecure_mode` (Boolean) Indicates whether the Splunk indexer certificate is not verified. Defaults to _true_.
- `output_data_format` (String) The format of the data sent to Splunk. Allowed values:

  * _CSV_
  * _CIM_

Defaults to _CSV_.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the Splunk destination.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Time when the object has been created.
- `id` (Number) The resource identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) Time when the object has been updated. Equals to _created_at_ if not updated after creation.
